text:
marta: quick intake — we got a new model 'zephyr-7B' from partner. Need a quant + calibration plan. Goals: ~2x cost reduction vs fp16, p50 latency <60ms on A100S, and quality regression <1% on our eval suite. Who can own a prioritized plan?

alex: can you drop the calib dataset link and baseline evals?

marta: s3://rwd-infer/onboard/zephyr-7b/calib.jsonl (5k records ~200k tokens, balanced instr/chat/qa). Baseline fp16 evals are here: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/rwd-infer/onboard/zephyr-7b/baseline.json

eval-bot: baseline summary -> MMLU: 68.3, TruthfulQA: 47.1, LLavg (0-shot): ppl 12.4, chat-clamp ROUGE-L: 0.62

sam: propose int8 symmetric per-channel first (fast, lower mem). If int8 fails on long-context, try fp8 hybrid for attention + KV cache.

jen: also add long-context summarization and instruction-following to the regression checklist — those are sensitive to quant noise.

dario: rough plan I suggest: 1) static post-training quant int8 w/ per-channel weight quant + kl calibration on the provided 5k; 2) run sensitivity sweep: layer-wise MSE probe + eval-suite delta; 3) if regressions >0.8% on key metrics, try fp8 for attention layers (gguf packaging for deploy); 4) produce canary artifact and perf/cost report.

marta: sounds good. Target timeline?

dario: sensitivity sweep + eval (overnight on 4xA100S) -> 12h. Canary build + perf runs -> next day.

alex: small script to run calib: ```python quantize.py --model zephyr-7b --format gguf --precision int8 --calib s3://rwd-infer/onboard/zephyr-7b/calib.jsonl --out /tmp/zephyr7b-int8.gguf --per-channel```

ci-bot: CI job queued: rwd-quant/zephyr7b/ci#2845 -> https://ci.redwood.ai/job/2845 (logs will appear there).

sam: I'll kick off the int8 sweep tonight and attach logs. Prioritize: int8 static -> int8 awq -> fp8 hybrid fallback.

jen: small eval note — please include few-shot code-execution style prompts and a 4k-context doc summarization probe. Those catch hallucination regressions.

alex: quick cost calc: if token cost drops 45% and latency holds, we save ~0.6x GPUs for peak traffic -> est monthly savings $7-9k for current pilot traffic. YMMV. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

marta: good. Who owns merging artifacts + canary schedule? @sam?

sam: i'll own artifact + canary. planning 3-step canary: 5% traffic (internal), 25% staged, 100% after 48h checks.

dario: add regression gate: any metric delta >1% rollback automatic. Also run perf microbench for KV cache warmup.

jen: +1 on rollback gate. Also archive all calibration seeds/configs for reproducibility.

marta: perfect. I'll create a PR with a checklist and assign tasks. Tasks: sam=run int8 sweep, dario=run sensitivity probes, alex=cost calc + infra, jen=regression tests. ci-bot: please attach job result links when done. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: FYI after last run on fp16 baseline: long-context summarization SARI 18.2, instr-follow EM 72.4

marta: thanks — pinging @sam to start overnight. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30am PT for results and next-step decision.

sam: on it.

ci-bot: job rwd-quant/zephyr7b/ci#2845 started at 2149901600, will post artifacts to s3://rwd-infer/onboard/zephyr-7b/ci/2845/

marta: closing loop — I'll update the intake board and label priority=high.
